/root/work/sign-product/send-venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import json, hashlib, os
R = '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/'
d = json.load(open(R + 'docs/implementation/c2a-r27/starting-hashes.json'))
print('placement.py in snapshot', d.get('backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py', '')[:12])
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(open(R + p, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
snap = dict((k, v) for k, v in d.items() if k.startswith('backend/dealroom_sign/tests/'))
disk = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(R + 'backend/dealroom_sign/tests'):
    dirs[:] = [x for x in dirs if x != '__pycache__']
    for f in files: disk.append(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, f), R))
changed = [k for k in snap if k in disk and sha(k) != snap[k]]
missing = [k for k in snap if k not in disk]
new = sorted(k for k in disk if k not in snap)
print('snapshot test files', len(snap), 'on disk', len(disk)); print('changed', changed); print('deleted', missing); print('new', new)
for k in new: print(k, sum(1 for _ in open(R + k)), 'lines')
pyc = [k for k in disk if k.endswith('.pyc')]; print('pyc', pyc[:5])
EOF
